answer: Problem: sybil farms mint many voting keys from one wallet and treat them as independent workers. Mechanism: each newcomer fires one clay token in a shared grove kiln, stained with umber pigment bound to a ferrous-filings serial unique to its funding parent, then cools 36 hours. Cost is 6.8 POA of kiln fuel, doubled for every extra token from the same parent. Verification: the kiln log matches the ferrous serial to the umber chromatogram and rejects a second parent firing. Failure: a stain mismatch slashes leftover fuel and bars that parent from the grove kiln for 4 epochs.
